El hecho está vigente: no hay nada que r: The fact is current: there is nothing to reactivate.
El hecho volvió a estar vigente mientras: The fact became current again while the reactivation was being reviewed: reject it.
Propone invalidar un hecho que ya no es: Proposes invalidating a fact that is no longer true, by its uuid (the one `facts_about`, `timeline` or `whats_new` give), with the reason and, if you know it, the text that replaces it. With `action: "reactivate"` it proposes the opposite: making a fact that was invalidated by mistake current again (a wrong supersession, for example); it is the only way to do it, because a text memory that explains it adds new facts but does not reactivate the invalidated one. It always stays in quarantine until a person with the curator role approves it, also if this token is a curator's; on approval the fact is invalidated (or reactivated), never deleted, and the replacement is saved as a new memory.
Reactivación propuesta: queda en cuarent: Reactivation proposed: it stays in quarantine until a curator approves it (proposal #{{id}}).
«invalidate» (por defecto) para un hecho: «invalidate» (the default) for a current fact that is no longer true; «reactivate» for an invalidated fact that is still true.
